environment: Local Docker Desktop Linux, Python 3.12, FFmpeg 7.1.5 Debian 13; NOT a hosted CircleCI benchmark
fixture: Existing smoke generators; 25 scenes, synthetic narration and English captions, mixed transitions, cold clips
includes: Media assembly and full decode validation
excludes: CI queue/install, network transfers, fixture creation, generation
memory_method: 20ms cgroup resident sampling excluding inactive file cache; includes Python and FFmpeg

runs.variant: two-scene candidate; concurrent constrained benchmark on same host
constrained safety check; concurrent candidate benchmark on same host

interpretation: Selected auto strategy reduced media time by 32.2% versus the 2GiB low_memory baseline. Larger batches did not show a consistent one-CPU advantage across these limited samples. Auto permits 1.5GiB; it does not artificially fill memory. Multi-CPU workers may use larger memory-budgeted batches. No general fastest-render or end-to-end CircleCI time guarantee.
